1561-pagan-and-christian-creeds-their-or.title: Pagan And Christian Creeds Their Origin And Meaning
1561-pagan-and-christian-creeds-their-or.creator: Edward Carpenter
1561-pagan-and-christian-creeds-their-or.description: A book by Edward Carpenter. The more facts, statistics, and so forth, there are available in any investigation, the easier it is to pick out a considerable number which will fit a given theory. The other facts being neglected or ignored, the views put forward enjoy for a time a great vogue. Then inevitably, and at a later time, new or neglected facts alter the outlook, and a new perspective is established.

arxiv-2104-05044.title: USACv20: robust essential, fundamental and homography matrix estimation
arxiv-2104-05044.creator: Maksym Ivashechkin, Daniel Barath, Jiri Matas
arxiv-2104-05044.description: Abstract We review the most recent RANSAC-like hypothesize-and-verify robust estimators. The best performing ones are combined to create a state-of-the-art version of the Universal Sample Consensus (USAC) algorithm. A recent objective is to implement a modular and optimized framework, making future RANSAC modules easy to be included.

arxiv-2209-05099.title: Empirical determination of the Bohr-Weisskopf effect in cesium and improved tests of precision atomic theory in searches for new physics
arxiv-2209-05099.creator: G. Sanamyan, B. M. Roberts, J. S. M. Ginges
arxiv-2209-05099.description: Abstract The finite distribution of the nuclear magnetic moment across the nucleus gives a contribution to the hyperfine structure known as the Bohr-Weisskopf (BW) effect. We have obtained an empirical value of − 0.24 ​ ( 18 ) % -0.24(18)\% for this effect in the ground and excited s s states of atomic 133 Cs.

arxiv-2303-15660.title: Graphs with queue number three and unbounded stack number
arxiv-2303-15660.creator: Yui Hin Arvin Leung
arxiv-2303-15660.description: Abstract We prove that the graphs T ⧄ P T\boxslash P have unbounded stack number and queue number 3 3 , where T T is a tree and P P is a path, and ⧄ \boxslash denotes the graph strong product but with one of the directions removed.

arxiv-2410-04896.title: Extensions of 𝒦 ​ ℒ \mathcal{KL} and Lyapunov Functions for Discrete-time Dynamical System Peak Analysis
arxiv-2410-04896.creator: Assalé Adjé
arxiv-2410-04896.description: Abstract In this paper, we extend two classes of functions that are classically involved in asymptotic stability analyses.The purpose of this extension is to study a maximization problem on the reachable values of a discrete-time dynamical system. This particular maximization problem is called a peak computation problem.

arxiv-2506-19119.title: Carbon Cycle Extremes Accelerate Weakening of the Land Carbon Sink in the Late 21st Century
arxiv-2506-19119.description: Abstract Increasing surface temperature could lead to enhanced evaporation, reduced soil moisture availability, and more frequent droughts and heat waves. The spatiotemporal co-occurrence of such effects further drives extreme anomalies in vegetation productivity and net land carbon storage. However, the impacts of climate change on extremes in net biospheric production (NBP) over longer time periods are unknown.

arxiv-2507-08035.title: Quantum theory of nonlinear electromagnetic response
arxiv-2507-08035.creator: Anwei Zhang, C. M. Wang
arxiv-2507-08035.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anwei Zhang, C. M. Wang. In recent years, the investigation of nonlinear electromagnetic responses has received significant attention due to its potential for elucidating the quantum properties of matter. Although remarkable progress has been achieved in developing quantum theories of nonlinear responses to electric field, a comprehensive quantum theory framework that systematically addresses nonlinear responses to both electric and magnetic fields has yet to be thoroughly discussed.

arxiv-2509-00077.title: Amplifying Emotional Signals: Data-Efficient Deep Learning for Robust Speech Emotion Recognition
arxiv-2509-00077.creator: Tai Vu
arxiv-2509-00077.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tai Vu. Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) presents a significant yet persistent challenge in human-computer interaction. While deep learning has advanced spoken language processing, achieving high performance on limited datasets remains a critical hurdle. This paper confronts this issue by developing and evaluating a suite of machine learning models, including Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTMs), and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), for automated emotion classification in human speech.

arxiv-2601-16312.creator: Dikshya Mohanty, Mohammad Saqib Hasan, Syed Mostofa Monsur, Size Zheng
arxiv-2601-16312.description: Abstract Research in AI4Science has shown promise in many science applications, including polymer design. However, current LLMs prove ineffective on this problem space because: (i) most models lack polymer-specific knowledge (ii) existing aligned models lack coverage of knowledge and capabilities relevant to polymer design.

pmc-10567925.title: Unmet Needs in the Treatment of Childhood Type 2 Diabetes: A Narrative Review
pmc-10567925.creator: William Tamborlane, Naim Shehadeh
pmc-10567925.description: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) in youth is a global health concern characterized by an increasing incidence and prevalence, especially among disadvantaged socioeconomic subgroups. Moreover, youth-onset T2D is more aggressive and causes earlier, more severe long-term cardio-renal complications compared with T2D in adults.

pmc-10572831.title: Presence of Non-Diabetic Kidney Diseases in Biopsy Specimens of Diabetic Patients’ Single Center Experience
pmc-10572831.creator: Aleksandar Janković, Nada Dimković, Verica Todorov-Sakić, Ana Bulatović, Nikola Simović, Petar Đurić, Radomir Naumović
pmc-10572831.description: The complications of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) are well known and one of them is diabetic chronic kidney disease (DCKD). Over time, it has become clear that patients with T2DM can have nondiabetic chronic kidney diseases (NDCKD), especially those that affect the glomeruli.

pmc-10654610.title: Influence of horse demographics, country of training and race distance on the rating of Thoroughbreds
pmc-10654610.creator: Eva Sobotková, Tomáš Kopec, Vladimír Mikule, Dana Kuřitková
pmc-10654610.description: The aim of the research was to assess how age, sex, sire, country of foaling, country of training and race distance influenced the international racing and performance of Thoroughbreds. The research was based on performance ratings of 6216 horses assigned by the International Federation of Racing Authorities between 2004 and 2022. The most common sex was stallion (58.

pmc-11372717.title: Sclerotherapy with absolute alcohol in a child with spinal aneurysmal bone cyst: A case report
pmc-11372717.creator: Eppy Buchori Aristiyadi K, Abdul Kadir Hadar, Hermin Aminah Usman, Andreas Klemens Wienanda, Harry Galuh Nugraha, Hilman
pmc-11372717.description: Aneurysmal bone cyst (ABC) is a benign and locally proliferative vascular disorder in the form of a non-neoplastic bone lesion commonly found in children and young adults. Several treatments and therapeutic options are available. Percutaneous sclerotherapy is an alternative treatment for ABC with less morbidity than other therapies.

pmc-11405404.title: In silico evaluation of cell therapy in acute versus chronic infarction: role of automaticity, heterogeneity and Purkinje in human
pmc-11405404.creator: Leto Luana Riebel, Zhinuo Jenny Wang, Hector Martinez-Navarro, Cristian Trovato, Julia Camps, Lucas Arantes Berg, Xin Zhou, Ruben Doste, Rafael Sachetto Oliveira, Rodrigo Weber dos Santos, Jacopo Biasetti, Blanca Rodriguez
pmc-11405404.description: Human-based modelling and simulation offer an ideal testbed for novel medical therapies to guide experimental and clinical studies. Myocardial infarction (MI) is a common cause of heart failure and mortality, for which novel therapies are urgently needed. Although cell therapy offers promise, electrophysiological heterogeneity raises pro-arrhythmic safety concerns, where underlying complex spatio-temporal dynamics cannot be investigated experimentally.

pmc-11772160.title: Case report: Overlapping syndrome of MOG-IgG associated optic neuritis and autoimmune encephalitis with co-existence of anti-NMDAR and anti-GABABR antibodies
pmc-11772160.creator: Zhujun Mei, Jingguo Wang, Junling Wang, Xiaoni Liu, Bo Deng, Wenbo Yang, Xiang Zhang, Xiangjun Chen, Hai Yu
pmc-11772160.description: We report a case of optic neuritis (ON) secondary to autoimmune encephalitis (AE) in a patient with concomitant antibodies to N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR), gamma-aminobutyric acid-B receptor (GABABR), and myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein (MOG). The patient exhibited a constellation of symptoms, including vision loss, seizures, mental and behavioral disorders, cognitive impairment, and speech abnormalities.

pmc-12576042.title: Systematic review and network meta-analysis of the effects of bioactive compounds on pain intensity and quality of life in neuropathic pain patients
pmc-12576042.creator: Rong Tang, Chao-Yang Gong, Yu-Qian Liu, Yingbin Wang, Hai-Yu Zhou
pmc-12576042.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). pmc-12602578.title: Development and validation of an 18F-FDG PET/CT radiomic nomogram for predicting axillary lymph-node status after neoadjuvant chemotherapy for breast cancer: a multicenter study
pmc-12602578.creator: Yu Li, Kun Chen, Luqiang Jin, Hailin Huang
pmc-12602578.description: Rationale and objectiveTo develop and validate the predictive value of 18F-FDG PET/CT radiomics models based on data preprocessing methods for axillary lymph-node (ALN) status after neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) for breast cancer.Materials and methodsAccording to the status of ALN after NAC, we divided the breast cancer patients of the three scanners into the pathological complete remission (pCR) and non-pCR groups, respectively.

pmc-12676487.title: Safety aspects of de novo DCB-only PCI—a practical checklist and a simplified revised dissection classification
pmc-12676487.creator: Natasha H. Corballis, Ioannis Merinopoulos, Rajkumar Natarajan, Tharusha Gunawardena, Upul Wickramarachchi, Vassilios S. Vassiliou, Antonio Colombo, Bruno Scheller, Simon Eccleshall
pmc-12676487.description: There is increasing use of drug-coated balloons (DCBs) in de novo coronary disease, supported by an ever-expanding evidence base. However, DCB-only angioplasty requires a slightly modified lesion preparation strategy to ensure an optimal angioplasty result and minimise the risk of vessel-threatening dissection.

pmc-13384567.title: Alcohol-based microextraction of Rhodamine 6G from soft drink, food, and cosmetic samples
pmc-13384567.creator: Mustafa SOYLAK, Esra YAMANER, Özgür ÖZALP
pmc-13384567.description: By using alcohol-based solvent extraction without tetrahydrofuran, a liquid–liquid microextraction technique was developed for the separation–enrichment of trace levels of Rhodamine 6G from complex matrices, including soft drinks, food, cosmetics, hygiene products, and natural waters. Numerous experimental parameters were tuned, including pH, alcohol volume, ultrasonication time, and sample and eluent volume.

pmc-13415018.title: From Mechanisms to Practice: Gut Microbiome-Based Strategies for Supporting Recovery in Elite Athletes
pmc-13415018.creator: Junior Carlone, Paolo Sgrò, Attilio Parisi, Alessio Fasano
pmc-13415018.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Recovery in elite athletes represents a critical determinant of performance and health outcomes. The gut microbiota has been proposed as a modulating factor for recovery through anti-inflammatory mechanisms, oxidative stress management, sleep regulation, and biosynthetic potential for essential micronutrients. This review examines the mechanisms linking gut microbiota composition and function to athletic recovery and critically evaluates the evidence supporting its application in sports medicine.

pmc-13436080.title: Acupuncture Combined with Herbal Cake-Separated Moxibustion for Chronic Pelvic Pain in Sequelae of Pelvic Inflammatory Disease: Study Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13436080.creator: Lingyu Qi, Yigong Fang, Dongxue An, Jiaxi Meng, Li Yang, Jiashan Li, Tian Hang, Huanfang Xu
pmc-13436080.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAcupuncture combined with herbal cake-separated moxibustion may be an effective treatment option for chronic pelvic pain (CPP) in sequelae of pelvic inflammatory disease (SPID), yet safety and feasibility evidence remain scarce.MethodsThis is a single-center, two-arm randomized controlled clinical trial. Eligible participants will be randomly assigned to the experiment group (acupuncture combined with herbal cake-separated moxibustion) or the control group (acupuncture only) in a 1:1 ratio.

pmc-13663893.title: A comprehensive model for gynecologic cancer patients' survivorship care
pmc-13663893.creator: Victoria E Rodriguez, Rachel Frankenthal, Jessica Walchonski, Beth Y Karlan, Dana M Chase
pmc-13663893.description: ObjectivesThe population of gynecologic cancer survivors is rapidly increasing, yet survivorship care remains fragmented and often focused primarily on surveillance for disease recurrence. This review aims to define the key domains shaping survivorship and propose a comprehensive, patient-centered model for gynecologic oncology.MethodsOur narrative reviews and synthesizes current evidence and clinical perspectives to examine gynecologic cancer survivorship.

uslaw-usc-t16-s577a.title: 16 U.S.C. § 577a — Conserving shore line beauty for recreational use of public lands in northern Minnesota; regulation of logging
uslaw-usc-t16-s577a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s577a.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 3 (Forests; Forest Service; Reforestation; Management); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The principle of conserving the natural beauty of shore lines for recreational use shall apply to all Federal lands which border upon any boundary lake or stream contiguous to this area, or any other lake or stream within this area.
